verdict.rationale: Asana offers AI Studio for building custom no-code AI agents/workflows and 'custom AI Teammates' with shared memory, governance, and scoped permissions, directly matching the ability to build/configure custom AI agents. However, evidence is entirely vendor-sourced marketing copy with no hands-on/independent verification of how customizable these agents really are, and details on configuration depth (e.g., model choice, tool access, testing) are thin. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of agent-building experience, technical depth on customization limits, and user reviews confirming real-world configurability.
